key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Widely branching spiny herb to roughly 0.8 m; stems prickly throughout.

key_traits.label: Foliage
key_traits.text: Leaves deeply lobed; lower surface sparingly to copiously prickly on and sometimes between veins; upper surface less prickly.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Large white flower, roughly 8–12 cm broad; numerous stamens.

key_traits.label: Bud sepals
key_traits.text: Bud body about 18–25 × 14–18 mm; sepal horns angular or flattened, about 8–12 mm, prickly.

key_traits.label: Capsule
key_traits.text: Ovoid, about 40–50 × 15–25 mm excluding prickles; prickles very unequal, often branched, with the longest commonly 15–35 mm.

key_traits.label: Flowering
key_traits.text: Spring through summer; fruiting summer through fall.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Fresh latex is orange to reddish-orange; A. albiflora subsp. texana is pale/light yellow.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Mature capsule prickles are very unequal, often branched, and extremely long; longest about 15–35 mm.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Sepal horns are about 8–12 mm and prickly.
